misprints.note: Headword is printed without the second i, so it was kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The breathing mark over ι in 'πόλεις, αἱ.' and 'ἀναγραφαί, αἱ.' has a hooked tail that could pass for an accent. I read it as a plain rough breathing, as on the pages already proofread. The same reading is used for αἱ in strips 03, 04 and 05.
